meta.title: Exa Search
meta.description: Semantic web search and URL reading through Exa, with multi-key routing and Team Management budget and usage.

card.summary: Manage Exa API keys, key routing, and Team Management budgets and usage. The built-in web_search is never replaced.
card.intro: Exa keys are tried in the order shown. Priority mode starts at the first key every time; round-robin rotates the starting key. A 401, 402, or 429 response moves that call to the next key. Built-in web_search is unaffected.
card.strategy.title: Key routing
card.strategy.label: Routing strategy
card.strategy.priorityHint: Each call starts with the first key. Later keys are fallbacks.
card.strategy.roundRobinHint: Each call starts with the next key in the list. Fallbacks continue from there.
card.strategy.failed: Could not save the routing strategy.
card.keys.title: API keys
card.keys.subtitle: The top key is primary. Drag the handle or use the arrow buttons to change the draft order, then save it.
card.keys.empty: No Exa API key is configured yet.
card.keys.addPlaceholder: Paste one or more Exa API keys, separated by commas or new lines
card.keys.addHint: The server trims whitespace, removes empty entries, and ignores keys that are already configured.
card.keys.noNewKeys: No new keys were added; every supplied key is already configured.
card.keys.primaryTitle: Primary — the first key tried in priority mode
card.keys.readOnlyHint: These keys come from the environment that launched dsh. Unset EXA_API_KEYS or EXA_API_KEY in that shell and restart dsh to manage them here.
card.keys.unsavedOrder: Order changes are not saved yet.
card.keys.orderFailed: Could not save the key order.
card.keys.readOnlyReasonPrimary: EXA_API_KEY is supplied read-only by the launching environment.
card.keys.readOnlyReasonList: EXA_API_KEYS is supplied read-only by the launching environment.
card.service.title: Team Management service key
card.service.subtitle: Optional. Team Management is enabled per team and needs a service account key created in the Exa dashboard's Service keys tab.
card.service.placeholder: Paste an Exa service account key
card.service.adminHint: Only Admin API reads are used. The service key is never used for search or fetch calls.
card.service.failed: Could not save the service key.
card.service.removeFailed: Could not remove the service key.
card.service.revealFailed: Could not reveal the service key.
card.usage.title: Budgets and usage
card.usage.subtitle: Usage is read from the Exa Team Management API for each linked key. Budget is the current billing-period limit; cost is the selected date range.
card.usage.notConfigured: Configure a Team Management service key to show budgets and usage. Key management and ordering still work without it.
card.usage.rangeInvalid: Enter a valid start and end date.
card.usage.rangeTooOld: The start date must be within the last 180 days.
card.usage.rangeReverse: The start date must not be after the end date.
card.usage.noBreakdown: No cost breakdown for this period.
card.usage.linkHint: The service key cannot reveal a normal key's ID. Choose the matching team key once; the association is stored without the secret.
card.usage.periodNote: Cost covers the selected range. Budget applies to the team's current billing period; the two are shown side by side and are not combined.
card.usage.budgetNote: Unlimited or unset budgets are shown as “No budget set”. A budget overrun is reported by Exa as isOverBudget.
card.usage.serviceRequired: A Team Management service key is required for usage data.
card.usage.linkFailed: Could not save the key association.
card.usage.adminError: The Team Management API rejected the request.
card.footer: Exa search, advanced search, and fetch are additional tools. Built-in web_search and web_fetch keep their existing providers and schemas.
card.error.readonly_keys: EXA_API_KEYS is supplied read-only by the launching environment. Unset it there and restart dsh, or edit ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml.
card.error.readonly_primary: EXA_API_KEY is supplied read-only by the launching environment. Unset it there and restart dsh.
card.error.readonly_service: EXA_SERVICE_API_KEY is supplied read-only by the launching environment. Unset it there and restart dsh.
card.error.key_not_found: That key is no longer configured. Reload the card.
card.error.invalid_order: The order must list every current key exactly once.
card.error.invalid_value: The supplied value is not valid.
card.error.admin_unauthorized: The service key was rejected. Check that it is a Team Management service key.
card.error.admin_forbidden: The service key lacks permission for this team.
card.error.admin_not_found: The team key was not found. Reload the usage rows.
card.error.admin_unreachable: Could not reach the Team Management API.
card.error.usage_unavailable: Usage is unavailable for this key.
card.error.invalid_range: The requested date range is invalid.
card.error.range_too_old: The start date must be within the last 180 days.
card.error.range_reversed: The start date must not be after the end date.
card.error.unlinked: This key is not linked to a team key yet.
card.error.not_in_team: The linked team key is not in the current team key list.
